request.input_text: I own the CarbonDesk workspace and need to download last month's invoice.

jobs.output:
Workspace owners can download invoices and receipts from Settings, Billing, Invoice history. Members without owner access should ask a workspace owner. Contact billing support with the invoice identifier if the document is missing; do not send full card details. [KB-BILLING-001]
Report a suspected duplicate charge to billing support with the dates, amounts and invoice identifiers. Billing support reviews eligibility before approving a refund. No automatic refund or processing date is guaranteed. Never request full payment card details. [KB-BILLING-002]
Workspace owners can cancel subscription renewal under Settings, Billing, Manage plan. Cancellation keeps access until the end of the current paid period and prevents the next renewal. Cancellation alone does not refund previous charges. [KB-BILLING-003]
